title: Update all 9 provider ops structs: add sign/verify/agree/sess_reset NULL fields
description: All provider files need their crypto2dev_algo_ops struct initialisers updated to include the new fields (all NULL for non-asymmetric providers): wolfssl_sha.c, wolfssl_hmac.c, wolfssl_cmac.c, wolfssl_aes_cbc.c, wolfssl_aes_gcm.c, kcapi_skcipher.c, kcapi_hash.c, kcapi_aead.c, example_provider.c. No logic changes — only struct field additions.
